description: Multi-point indicator with power and energy calculation from 4-20 mA current and voltage inputs (special version), with Modbus RTU
source: Presys, DMY-2015 mA / RTD special version sheet EE1204-00

sources.title: Indicador digital multi-ponto DMY-2015 mA / RTD, versao especial, calculo de potencia
sources.note: register and coil tables of the new registers, linked in issue #392

notes: Special version that calculates power as POT x V x I x cos phi, where I is the average of 4-20 mA inputs 1 to 3 (the enabled ones) and V is input 4, and can totalise it into energy. Inputs 1 to 10 are shown (CA-1 to CA-10).

The sheet lists only the registers and coils that are new in this version. The registers of the standard DMY-2015 (communication settings, input types, filters, limits, offsets and the other alarm settings) are in the instrument's technical manual, which the issue does not link, and are not in this map. Registers 12 to 15, 73, 74, 192 to 196 and 198 to 202 and coils 103 to 107, 109 to 113 and 115 to 119 are not used.

The document numbers registers and coils from 00 and does not say whether they are the addresses sent on the wire; they are taken as wire addresses (address_base 0). If a read is off by one, try address_base 1.

The document does not say which Modbus function reads the registers; they are taken as holding registers. Process variables, setpoints and hysteresis values are given raw (divide by 10 to the power of the channel's decimals).

The sheet says to read the channels with Softgraph (model GERAL PRESYS) as: first process variable register = 1, decimals register = 209 and 12 channels, which is the document's register numbers plus one; this suggests the Softgraph numbering starts at 1, and the table is taken here with the numbers as printed.
Written from the manufacturer's document; not tested on a device.
